ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 60% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels and 40% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density of discrete, roughly circular black spots (diameter approx. 10-20 pixels) distributed across the white field of both lobes. Contiguous low-intensity regions are mapped to the central peduncle area and follow the perimeter of the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 85-degree V-shaped central depression with a deep bounding-box depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys (5-12 pixel height variance) along the continuous trailing edge boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a pronounced concave curve towards the tip; left lobe exhibits a moderate convex curvature along the outer margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast, irregular circular pixel textures at the distal tips and leading edge of the right lobe, indicative of surface colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy encrustation and structural surface irregularity at the tips and leading edges, particularly prominent on the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced hooked/curled morphology at the terminus of the right fluke lobe.
